The '''v-180 Planet Defender''' was a heavy [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]].

==Description==
This defensive, [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] ion cannon, built by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], was the most powerful planet-based artillery available on the market a few years before the [[Battle of Yavin 4]]. It possessed nearly twice the firepower of its predecessor, the [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|v-150]] and also had its own power generator.<ref name="HSCS" />

==History==
One of these cannons was supposed to be installed on [[Mytus VII/Legends|Mytus VII]], to defend the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]]. However, the prison was [[Liberation of Stars' End|destroyed]] before the defensive piece could be installed.<ref name="HSCS" />
